fusions.name: Heron's Lunge
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Lunges from cover for 20 damage, up to 1.8 times that at the full 7 tiles.

fusions.name: Barbed Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone of barbs 2.5 tiles long, dealing 6 damage to everything in it and leaving each [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Reed to Reed
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Startled Rise
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, a ward worth 25% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
